Understanding prayer times in Dubai

Dubai uses the engine’s Dubai convention and Asia/Dubai time. The timetable has no seasonal clock change, but solar movement changes prayer times throughout the year. The calculation is for central Dubai rather than every emirate. Use the Abu Dhabi page or your own city in the app when your location changes, and compare with the local authority’s timetable if minutes differ.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
